verdict.rationale: Task management is clearly ClickUp's category, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions subtasks, task dependencies, or blocking relationships. The only related items cover generic task creation via the API, custom task types and Sprints, and none of them document breaking work into subtasks or linking dependent tasks.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
